meta.title: Turn cost & context insights (official prices)
meta.description: Prices every completed turn and the running session total in CNY (default; switchable to USD) at each vendor's official list prices, with an optional session budget that turns red past the cap — official CNY rows used as-is, USD-only vendors converted and flagged. Context insights cover a Context tab, a right-sidebar Context panel, the /context command, a cross-session dashboard and their own Settings → Cost page. Surfaces use KPI tiles and cards: composition, token buckets with per-bucket money, cost breakdown, context trend (tokens / cost / cache-hit), cost by model, timing, file activity, agent network, context events and a filterable, sortable, CSV-exportable per-request browser; the dashboard adds a 7-day tokens/cost chart, a week-aligned activity heatmap, an all-session model leaderboard and searchable session cards. Unknown models show "price unknown" instead of $0.
